characters.continuity: Star Wars Canon (The Clone Wars / Revenge of the Sith)
characters.summary: Aayla Secura is a Jedi Knight and skilled military general who dual-wields lightsabers in a specialized reverse-grip style. She relies on acrobatic movement, tactical awareness, and a deep connection to the Force.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to betrayal when surrounded by loyal clone troopers under Order 66
limitations: Requires focus to maintain advanced Force techniques in active combat

sources.supports: Abilities, status as Jedi Knight, dual lightsaber combat, and death during Order 66.

feats.claim: Led clone trooper forces and engaged hostile droids on various Clone Wars battlefronts.
Gunned down by her own clone troopers on Felucia during Order 66.
feats.citation: Star Wars: Episode III - Revenge of the Sith

notableResults.citation: Star Wars: Episode III - Revenge of the Sith
notableResults.note: Ambushed by her own troops without warning.

campaignTags.claim: Can use Force leap for high airborne maneuverability
Pilots Republic starfighters and gunships during the Clone Wars

unknowns: Exact mastery level of Force abilities compared to Council members is not deeply specified in canon.

characters.continuity: Star Wars Canon (Return of the Jedi / Sequel Trilogy)
characters.summary: Gial Ackbar is a legendary Mon Calamari military commander and fleet admiral known for his tactical genius in large-scale space combat. He directs forces from command bridges rather than engaging in direct personal combat.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to personal physical combat and lacks direct combat abilities outside of command
limitations: Lacks personal combat training for frontline melee or ranged skirmishes

sources.supports: Military rank, tactical feats as fleet admiral, and leadership role in the Rebel Alliance.

feats.claim: Commanded the Rebel fleet at the Battle of Endor and orchestrated the trap maneuver against the second Death Star.
feats.citation: Star Wars: Episode VI - Return of the Jedi

notableResults.citation: Star Wars: Episode VI - Return of the Jedi
notableResults.note: Led fleet victory at Endor despite an initial imperial trap.

campaignTags.claim: Mon Calamari species naturally adapted to aquatic environments
Commands capital starships and directs naval combat operations

unknowns: Personal hand-to-hand combat skills are not documented.

characters.summary: Amilyn Holdo is a high-ranking Resistance Vice Admiral who uses unconventional tactics and absolute resolve to command fleeing forces. She is capable of sacrificing capital ships to decimate hostile armadas.
weaknesses: Lacks direct frontline combat prowess or personal weaponry proficiency
limitations: Relies entirely on starship infrastructure to execute offensive maneuvers

sources.supports: Resistance leadership, Vice Admiral rank, and hyperspace ramming feat.

feats.claim: Executed a lightspeed collision with the First Order dreadnought fleet, destroying the flagship and multiple escort ships.
feats.citation: Star Wars: Episode VIII - The Last Jedi

notableResults.citation: Star Wars: Episode VIII - The Last Jedi
notableResults.note: Destroyed a massive portion of the pursuing fleet via hyperspace ramming.

campaignTags.claim: Commands capital starships as Vice Admiral

unknowns: Combat proficiency outside of starship command is unproven.

characters.continuity: Star Wars Canon (The Clone Wars / Rebels)
characters.summary: Ahsoka Tano is an agile and formidable force-wielder who utilizes a dual-wielding reverse-grip lightsaber style (Shien). She combines high acrobatic mobility with strong defensive parries and Force abilities.
weaknesses: Prone to overconfidence in early training years; vulnerable to emotional attachments

sources.supports: Abilities, dual lightsabers, Force powers, and combat history across multiple eras.

feats.claim: Fought and defeated numerous battle droids, inquisitors, and managed to duel Darth Vader.

notableResults.citation: Star Wars Rebels - Twilight of the Apprentice
notableResults.note: Rescued from a fatal blow via World Between Worlds intervention.

campaignTags.claim: Performs massive Force-enhanced leaps and aerial maneuvers

unknowns: Full extent of her potential without lightsabers is rarely tested.

characters.summary: Having evolved past her previous Jedi identity, Ahsoka the White wields twin white-bladed lightsabers and demonstrates heightened spiritual connection to the Force, granting superior clarity and combat presence.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to psychological manipulation regarding her past and relationship with Anakin Skywalker
characters.formDifferences: Represents Ahsoka after her resurrection/evolution via the World Between Worlds, wielding purified white crystals in her lightsabers and exhibiting mastery over dark-side corruption.

sources.supports: Ahsoka the White transformation, white lightsabers, and advanced spiritual state.

unknowns: Exact limits of her resurrected state are still unfolding in later series eras.

characters.continuity: Star Wars Canon (The Clone Wars / Revenge of the Sith)
characters.summary: Anakin Skywalker is one of the most powerful Force-wielders in galactic history, utilizing an aggressive Djem So lightsaber style coupled with immense telekinetic power and reckless tactical daring.
weaknesses: Prone to intense emotional volatility, hubris, and anger
limitations: Prone to over-reliance on brute force over cautious strategy

sources.supports: Abilities, Djem So fighting style, Force power, and cybernetics.

feats.claim: Defeated Count Dooku in single combat aboard the Invisible Hand.
feats.citation: Star Wars: Episode III - Revenge of the Sith

notableResults.citation: Star Wars: Episode III - Revenge of the Sith
notableResults.note: Overcame Dooku by channeling the dark side during their duel.

campaignTags.claim: Executes extraordinary Force-powered jumps and acrobatic movements
Renowned starfighter pilot capable of flying almost any vessel

unknowns: The absolute ceiling of his raw midi-chlorian potential if he had not been injured on Mustafar.

characters.summary: Asajj Ventress is a former Nightsister assassin and Sith acolyte who wields dual curved lightsabers that can combine into a single saberstaff. She combines dark-side martial arts, stealth, and Nightsister magicks.
weaknesses: Prone to arrogance and vengeful fixations
limitations: Magical rituals require preparation time and focus

sources.supports: Abilities, Nightsister heritage, dual curved lightsabers, and assassination training.

feats.claim: Assassinated and dueled multiple Jedi Knights across the Clone Wars galaxy.

notableResults.note: Defeated after an intense duel on Teth.

campaignTags.claim: Trained in Nightsister magick and spellcasting
Utilizes assassination stealth and ambush tactics

unknowns: Exact limitations of her dark-side stamina during prolonged campaigns.

characters.summary: Aurra Sing is a lethal bounty hunter with sniper training, enhanced reflexes, and a merciless demeanor. She utilizes long-range weaponry, concealed blasters, and tactical assassinations.
weaknesses: Lacks heavy defensive resilience against Force powers or direct lightsaber onslaughts
limitations: Dependent on equipment and vantage points for sniping efficiency

sources.supports: Bounty hunter status, sniper skills, and weapons expertise.

feats.claim: Successfully targeted and eliminated numerous high-profile political and military targets across the galaxy.

notableResults.note: Defeated and captured after attempting to assassinate Senator Amidala.

campaignTags.claim: Pilots custom starships and getaway vessels

unknowns: Extent of her cybernetic enhancements in canon vs legends.
Unsupported by cited source (term check, 1/5 key terms found): stealth: Employs stalking and sniping camouflage tactics

characters.continuity: Star Wars Canon (Revenge of the Sith / Rebels)
characters.summary: Bail Organa is a principled Senator from Alderaan and a founding leader of the Rebel Alliance. He operates primarily through political influence, diplomacy, and covert resource allocation rather than personal combat.
weaknesses: Lacks combat training or physical offense capabilities

sources.supports: Senator status, role as a Rebel founder, and political resistance history.

feats.claim: Helped rescue Yoda and Obi-Wan Kenobi during the execution of Order 66.
feats.citation: Star Wars: Episode III - Revenge of the Sith

notableResults.note: Operated covertly against imperial oversight until Alderaan's destruction.

campaignTags.claim: Pilots consular transport craft and official speeders

unknowns: Direct tactical decisions in ground combat are unrecorded.

characters.continuity: Star Wars Canon (The Clone Wars / Prequel Trilogy)
characters.summary: Standard B1 battle droids are mass-produced infantry units controlled by a central command network. They fight in synchronized squads using standard blaster rifles, relying on numerical superiority rather than individual skill.
weaknesses: Fragile mechanical structure; prone to comedic malfunctions; dependent on command signal
limitations: Lacks independent tactical adaptability without central processor connection

sources.supports: Mass production, droid weaponry, and mechanical vulnerabilities.

feats.claim: Participated in massive invasions and skirmishes across the Clone Wars galaxy.
feats.citation: Star Wars: Episode I - The Phantom Menace

notableResults.note: Regularly overwhelmed in large-scale engagements by disciplined clone forces.

unknowns: Exact durability variations across different factory batches.
